jobs.description:
Robert Half is seeking an Engineering Technician to support municipal engineering, development review, permitting, and public works activities. This Engineering Technician position provides a combination of office and field technical engineering support, including reviewing construction and subdivision plans, assisting with development review, preparing engineering drawings, supporting field survey activities, and issuing encroachment permits.

The ideal Engineering Technician candidate will have experience working with civil engineering plans, land development, public works projects, surveying, or municipal engineering and be comfortable working with engineers, contractors, developers, property owners, and the general public. This Engineering Technician role is an Onsite position out of Fairfield and can be Part-time as well.


Key Responsibilities

  • Review subdivision final maps, parcel maps, and construction plans for compliance with City Planning and Engineering requirements and accepted construction practices.
  • Review and interpret civil engineering plans associated with streets, utilities, land development, and public infrastructure improvements.
  • Prepare engineering plans, specifications, profiles, cross-sections, and related technical drawings.
  • Perform horizontal and vertical alignment calculations and other engineering computations supporting:
  • Street improvements
  • Curb and gutter construction
  • Sewer systems
  • Water systems
  • Storm drainage
  • Parks and other public improvement projects
  • Assist with the development review process, including review and coordination of plans submitted for private and public improvement projects.
  • Process and issue encroachment permits in accordance with City requirements.
  • Provide flood zone determinations and respond to requests for general engineering and development information.
  • Participate as a member of a field survey crew, gathering and documenting field data for planning, engineering, and public works projects.
  • Assist with construction staking, improvement-site surveys, and property boundary surveys.
  • Use surveying equipment to obtain accurate field measurements and assist with survey calculations.
  • Reproduce, organize, and assemble engineering plans, specifications, maps, and related documents.
  • Maintain accurate records associated with engineering drawings, surveys, permits, and field activities.
  • Prepare technical documentation and reports as required.
  • Coordinate and communicate with City employees, engineers, contractors, developers, property owners, and members of the public.
  • Perform other related engineering support duties as assigned.
jobs.skills:
Knowledge & Technical Skills

Candidates should have knowledge of or experience with:

  • Basic civil engineering principles and practices used in engineering drawing, plan review, and field survey work.
  • Reading and interpreting construction plans, subdivision maps, parcel maps, engineering drawings, and specifications.
  • Computer-aided design and drafting (CAD) software.
  • Engineering drafting practices and equipment.
  • Basic surveying principles, equipment, measurements, and calculations.
  • Public works and land-development construction practices.
  • Construction safety standards and regulations.
  • Municipal development review and permitting processes.
  • Encroachment permits and public right-of-way projects.

Knowledge of the following is highly desirable:

  • California Subdivision Map Act
  • Municipal engineering and public works procedures

Required Abilities

  • Read and interpret subdivision maps, parcel maps, construction plans, and engineering drawings.
  • Perform technical engineering calculations with accuracy.
  • Use drafting tools and computer-aided drafting software.
  • Use or assist with surveying equipment and accurately record field measurements.
  • Perform both office and field-based technical engineering work.
  • Review plans and documentation for completeness and compliance with established requirements.
  • Maintain organized and accurate engineering, survey, and permit records.
  • Communicate technical information effectively, both verbally and in writing.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with City employees, contractors, developers, engineers, property owners, and the general public.
  • Manage multiple projects, reviews, and requests while maintaining strong attention to detail.

Ideal Background

The strongest candidates will have previous experience as an Engineering Technician, Civil Engineering Technician, Public Works Technician, Development Review Technician, Survey Technician, or similar role within a city, county, engineering firm, public works department, or land-development environment.

Experience combining civil plan review, CAD/drafting, surveying, development review, and encroachment permitting would be particularly relevant.

jobs.description:
Robert Half is searching a Senior Network Engineer to support corporate network infrastructure with a strong focus on FortiGate firewalls and FortiGate SD-WAN solutions. This position is Hybrid (3 days onsite, 2 days remote) and is a 6 month contract with the potential to hire. Apply today!

Location: Hybrid – 3 days onsite in Seattle

(Tuesdays and Thursdays required; third day flexible)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST


Job Responsibilities:

  • Configure and maintain routing protocols and network connectivity within firewall and SD-WAN environments.
  • Support Layer 1 and Layer 2 switching and routing within a corporate IT networking environment.
  • Participate in the implementation of new SD-WAN solutions, including hands-on configuration, installation, testing, and troubleshooting.

jobs.description:
Robert Half is seeking a Senior COBOL Mainframe Developer with AWS experience to support an established insurance and financial services organization. If you feel this aligns with your background, apply today!

 

Schedule: Core availability 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM PST

Duration: 6-month contract, likely to extend or convert

Location: 100% Remote

Pay rate: $60-$65/hourly

 

Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for sponsorship.

 

Job Duties:

  • Develop, enhance, and maintain IBM mainframe applications supporting legacy insurance and retirement systems
  • Build and support APIs and integration layers to expose mainframe data and functionality to downstream platforms
  • Maintain and enhance COBOL-based systems, including batch processing and online transactions
  • Support KTLO (Keep the Lights On) work, production stability, and ongoing system maintenance
  • Design and implement AWS-based solutions as needed to support integrations and platform capabilities
  • Participate in technical design discussions to ensure system reliability, scalability, and long-term stability
  • Contribute to new capability development on top of existing legacy systems (not net-new policy platforms)
jobs.skills:

  • Strong experience with: COBOL, CICS, DB2, JCL, VSAM
  • Experience building or supporting APIs on the mainframe
  • Strong understanding of legacy systems, batch processing, and transaction-based architectures
  • Hands-on AWS experience is required, (AWS architect-level experience is not required.)
  • Experience with SOAP and/or REST integrations
  • Ability to work independently in a distributed team environment without dedicated AWS-only engineers

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience with Vantage or similar annuity / insurance policy administration systems
  • Prior experience in insurance or financial services environments
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools

jobs.description:
Senior Software Engineer

A leading firm based in Los Angeles, California is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join its technology organization. Technology and AI are central to its ongoing innovation strategy, with continued investment in intelligent applications, automation, and data-driven solutions.

This role will work closely with investment, operations, compliance, investor relations, accounting, and data teams to turn complex business processes into scalable technology solutions.

  • Build full-stack solutions using C#, .NET, SQL, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, APIs, and modern development frameworks.
  • Develop and support AI-enabled applications, agent workflows, document processing, and intelligent automation solutions.

  • Develop data and document processing workflows that extract, validate, transform, and load information into enterprise systems.

Additional Details

  • Quarterly travel may be required
  • Opportunity to join an organization with an established investment in AI and help build the next generation of internal AI capabilities
  • Direct collaboration with senior technology leadership and investment professionals

  • Strong Python experience for automation, data processing, scripting, or AI-enabled applications.
  • Professional experience within investment management, private equity, hedge funds, fixed income, or a closely related financial services environment.

Compensation & Benefits

jobs.description:
IT Help Desk Specialist


Company Overview

A growing professional services organization based in Los Angeles, California is seeking an IT Help Desk Specialist to provide responsive technology support to employees and help maintain reliable day-to-day IT operations. The organization offers a collaborative environment where team members can gain exposure to a broad range of Microsoft technologies while developing their technical skills and growing into additional IT responsibilities.


Role Summary

The IT Help Desk Specialist will serve as a first point of contact for employees experiencing technology issues. This role will provide hands-on support across Windows devices, Microsoft 365, user accounts, hardware, software, printers, networking, and remote connectivity. The ideal candidate has strong troubleshooting fundamentals, excellent customer service skills, and an interest in growing their career in IT support and systems administration.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide first-level technical support for employees through in-person, email, phone, collaboration tools, and ticketing channels.
  • Troubleshoot Windows, Microsoft 365, passwords, account lockouts, printers, peripherals, VPN, Wi-Fi, and basic network connectivity issues.
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including user account setup, access changes, and workstation preparation.
  • Configure, deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot laptops, desktops, software, and other workplace technology.
  • Manage support requests through the IT ticketing system, documenting troubleshooting steps and ensuring timely resolution or escalation.
  • Support Active Directory and cloud-based identity administration for routine user and access requests.
  • Maintain technology inventory, documentation, and internal knowledge resources.
  • Assist senior IT staff with software deployments, system testing, documentation, and company-wide technology projects.
  • Coordinate with technology vendors and escalate complex technical issues when appropriate.
  • Communicate technical solutions clearly and professionally to non-technical users.

Additional Details

  • Fully onsite
  • Standard schedule: 8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. with a one-hour lunch break
  • Occasional overtime may be required during peak business periods and month-end activities
  • Limited local travel may occasionally be required
  • Opportunity to gain experience across a broad Microsoft-focused IT environment and grow into more advanced technical responsibilities
jobs.skills:

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365 and common business productivity applications.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves)

Benefits: Eligible for Paid Time Off (PTO) and Paid Holidays over the course of the contract

Hours: 40 Weekly, Monday through Friday

Robert Half is seeking an experienced Tier 2 IT Support Specialist for a full-time contract opportunity in Lee, MA. This position is ideal for an IT professional who enjoys hands-on troubleshooting, supporting end users, and working closely with a collaborative IT team.


The selected candidate will provide technical support to employees, assist with desktop and user support issues, and help maintain daily IT operations. The initial contract is expected to last six months, with the potential for extension.
